status.readthrough_control: passed for G418, within one laboratory
status.readthrough_detail: The G418 positive control completes its signature on GSE144140, and SRI-37240 fails it in the stalling direction — so the assay detects canonical G418 readthrough. This is confirmation within one laboratory and protocol family, not independent replication, and it does not license a null about a therapy of different data quality, modality or context.
status.safety_detail: Native-stop occupancy is measured for G418 in HEK293T cells only; the other therapies have no matched empirical safety atlas. It is downstream occupancy past normal stops, not protein production, toxicity, or a result in any other tissue.

safety.unavailable_reason: the rest were not expressed at footprint depth in this cell line, so they carry a prediction but no measurement to compare it against
safety.concordance_label: modest rank concordance, with substantial disagreement
safety.caveat: Downstream occupancy past normal stops, not protein production, toxicity, or a result in any other tissue or therapy.
